title: Say only what happened
statement: Tell and record only what actually happened: no canned line posing as a response, no step the student didn't take, and an end screen that claims completion, never mastery.
detail: A per-decision audit of one reading lesson's build found a welcome screen that overclaimed contingent listening while giving the same recast whatever the student said, and a receipt screen that asserted out-loud and self-done events that had not happened on the typed paths (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0237-u4l2-carbon-copy-build-2026-08-13-to-08-21.qmd`). In the fixed build, a third attempt ends in a release framed as help, never as a solo pass. Nothing promises something the page lacks, a lesson counts as done only once its checks were attempted, help is named as help, and each recap is written for its own item.
against: In the lesson whose recaps were copied, the recaps were a record kept for adults and were not shown to students (`shadow-content-eval/reports/G3-U1-L2-main-review.md`, line 108).
